“噫，真的治好了！”
大厅内响起众人的惊叹，一道道目光齐刷刷聚焦在齐知玄身上。
“哈哈哈，治好了，治好了……”
老鸨喜出望外，激动地手足舞蹈，眼睛里又有了光。
转眼又过一炷香的时间。
随着时间推移，赵家公子的状态越来越好，能够自己站起来了。
危机彻底解除。
就在这时。
城东名医苏大夫，终于赶到。
仔细诊断后，苏大夫断言赵家公子病情轻微，无需吃药，静养三五日即可自行复原。
随后，收到消息的赵家主母火急火燎赶到，带走了赵家公子。
“嗐，这位赵公子应该是一个人偷偷跑出来玩的，身边连个扈从都没带。”
有人议论。
“万幸没事。”
老鸨擦了把汗，长松口气，心中阵阵后怕。
赵家是阳谷县豪强，财雄势大，叱咤风云。
倘若赵家公子真的死在了媚香楼，后果简直不堪设想。
老鸨、厨子、妓女等人，有一个算一个，必定都要给赵家公子陪葬。
所以……

老鸨暗暗庆幸，转过身，深深看了眼齐知玄，脸上的笑容逐渐灿烂，就像是绽放的菊花一样。
“大虎，你那个土法子是跟谁学的？”老鸨笑着问道。
齐知玄连道：“乡下有个走方郎中，经常来我们村子收购草药，我跟他学到了不少东西。”
老鸨恍然，略一沉吟，打开钱袋子，掏出一张宝钞，犹豫了下，又塞了回去，重新掏出一叠泥钞。
宝钞是流通货币的最大面额，类似人民币的一百元，又叫大钱。
相对的，泥钞则是小钱，也是一种纸钞，面额分为一和十，颜色如同黄泥，因此得名。
一宝钞等于一千泥钞。
按照集市上的物价计算，一个白面馒头是两泥钞。
另外，打工分为零工、短工和长工。
零工的日工资介于二十到七十泥钞。
短工的月工资，通常在一千八百泥钞以内。
二牛哥除了种地，还兼职做木匠，就属于短工这一类。
长工的月工资要好些，最低两千泥钞起步，上不封顶。
曾大义做龟奴，月收入是两千三百五十泥钞，管吃管住，小费另算，属于中下等收入群体。
按照阳谷县的收入和物价水平计算，维持正常生活开销大约需要每人每个月五百泥钞。
这一刻，老鸨刷刷点了五张泥钞，每张的面额都是十，恰好是五十泥钞，姿势豪爽地递给了齐知玄，笑道：“大虎，这是赏你的。”
见状，齐知玄心中不禁有些失望。

"Oh, it's really cured!"
Everyone's exclamations echoed in the hall, and all eyes focused on Qi Zhixuan.
"Hahaha, it's cured, it's cured..."
The madam was overjoyed, dancing with her hands and feet excitedly, and her eyes had light again.
In the blink of an eye, another stick of incense passed.
As time went by, Mr. Zhao's condition got better and better and he was able to stand up on his own.
The crisis is completely resolved.
Just then.
Dr. Su, a famous doctor from the east of the city, finally arrived.
After careful diagnosis, Dr. Su concluded that Mr. Zhao's condition was mild and he did not need to take medicine. He would recover on his own in three to five days of rest.
Later, after receiving the news, the Zhao family's mistress rushed over and took away the Zhao family's young master.
"Hey, this Mr. Zhao probably sneaked out to play alone, without even a follower."
There was discussion.
"Thankfully it's okay."
The madam wiped her sweat and breathed a sigh of relief, but was filled with fear.
The Zhao family is a powerful family in Yanggu County, rich and powerful, and dominates the world.
If Mr. Zhao really died in Meixiang Tower, the consequences would be unimaginable.
The madams, cooks, prostitutes, etc., every one of them, will definitely be buried with Mr. Zhao.
So...
The madam secretly rejoiced, turned around, and took a deep look at Qi Zhixuan. The smile on his face gradually became brighter, like a blooming chrysanthemum.
"Dahu, who did you learn that native trick from?" the madam asked with a smile.
Qi Zhixuan said: "There is a traveling doctor in the countryside who often comes to our village to buy herbs. I learned a lot from him."
The madam suddenly understood, pondered for a moment, opened the money bag, took out a treasure banknote, hesitated for a moment, stuffed it back, and took out another stack of mud banknotes.
Baobao is the largest denomination of currency in circulation, similar to one hundred yuan in RMB, and is also called big money.
In contrast, mud banknotes are small coins, also a kind of banknotes, with denominations of one and ten, and the color is like yellow mud, hence the name.
One treasure note is equal to one thousand mud notes.
According to the prices in the market, a white-faced steamed bun costs two yuan.
In addition, part-time workers are divided into odd workers, short-term workers and long-term workers.
The daily wage for casual workers ranges from 20 to 70 yuan.
The monthly salary of a day laborer is usually less than 1,800 yuan.
In addition to farming, Brother Erniu also works part-time as a carpenter, which falls into the category of day laborers.
The monthly salary of long-term workers is better, starting from a minimum of 2,000 yuan, with no upper limit.
Zeng Dayi worked as a turtle slave, and his monthly income was 2,350 yuan. He was responsible for food and housing, and tips were not included. He belonged to the lower-middle income group.
Based on the income and price levels of Yanggu County, it takes about 500 ni banknotes per person per month to maintain normal living expenses.
At this moment, the madam counted five clay notes, each with a denomination of ten, which happened to be fifty clay notes. He handed it to Qi Zhixuan with a bold gesture and said with a smile: "Dahu, this is a reward for you."
Seeing this, Qi Zhixuan couldn't help but feel a little disappointed.
